cultivation.title: Tribulations you endure
cultivation.summary: A tribulation is struck, not checked. The four realm-ending gates used to compare the stat line with three requirements, which a studied player cleared at 2.4–3.2× and knew the answer to before pressing.

cultivation.title: Artifact art, and a build that runs in a browser
cultivation.summary: Every artifact has its own icon. All 20 pieces were drawn as 32x32 PNGs — and the PNG is the original now, not a render of a text grid. The five weapons are jian: a straight double-edged blade with a short perpendicular guard, the later tiers carrying a tassel, in place of the sabre/western mix.

jp-subs.title: Ollama health check
jp-subs.summary: Ollama is a separate program people close, and the old failure mode was to start a run, extract the whole transcript, and only then hit the model call and die. The popup now probes before anything starts and disables Translate until the backend is actually usable.

jp-subs.title: Korean translation
jp-subs.summary: Step 3, and Korean now translates. Its quality has not been checked by a Korean reader, and the popup says so rather than presenting Korean and Japanese as equally trustworthy.

whisper-subs.title: A new window, line-shift check and streaming audio
whisper-subs.summary: The window has been rebuilt as a modern app, with file cards that show each stage's progress, switches instead of checkboxes, and a drop target that covers the whole window.

whisper-subs.title: Desktop app
whisper-subs.summary: A drag-and-drop window for anyone who would rather not use a terminal, and a standalone Windows build that needs no Python installed.

webnovel.summary:
Jinjiang (jjwxc.net free chapters). Its paragraphs are loose text between `
`s, not elements, which exposed Qidian assumptions in the content script. The adapter contract now hands over text nodes and a content root (§5.2).
